_comment: M6 Parallel Exposure Eligibility Policy. Controls which workflow types and project types may enter the FE-safe gated parallel execution path. Runtime reads this after production_parallel_rollout.json permits evaluation. Changing this file does not require a service restart.

ambiguous_routing.description: Deny if Brain Router confidence score is below threshold or route is mixed/ambiguous

high_context_overflow_risk.description: Deny if any prior step in this workflow class has p90 context usage above budget ceiling

dirty_repo_anchor_instability.description: Deny if repo state signals high patch anchor mismatch risk (dirty working tree or active merge conflict)

unapproved_workflow_class.description: Deny if workflow_type is not in allowed_workflow_types

unapproved_project_type.description: Deny if project_type is not in allowed_project_types

unapproved_input_class.description: Deny if input_class is not in fe_safe_eligible_input_classes

structural_completion_impossible.description: Deny if runtime structural guard detects that FE completion requires be_to_fe handoff material not available under the parallel path. This overrides all other allow conditions.
